name: Esplanade Cube Open 2026
information: #### * **Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event under any circumstances if you reach late.** * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification. * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc4NzE3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6570d2bfc844829617522414421236e17faaa42b/combined%20logo.jpg)
